$comment: High/critical npm advisories that CI tolerates. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); after it expires the gate fails again so the decision gets revisited. Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs.

entries.reason: No patched release (every version <=3.0.3 is affected). Reached only through dev tooling (eslint-config-next, @typescript-eslint, tailwindcss v3 via micromatch/fast-glob/chokidar) with glob patterns we write ourselves; not in shipped dependencies. npm's suggested fix is a major downgrade (eslint-config-next@14).
